tools.description: List the available AI models with their kind (image, video), default cost in credits (1 credit = $0.012, or €0.01 when billed in euros) and billable options. Call this before generating if you need a specific model, otherwise sensible defaults are used.

kind.description: Only return models of this kind.

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List Imaginode models

tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt (optionally with input images for editing or reference). Waits for the result and returns the image URL. Costs credits from the connected Imaginode account; failures are refunded.

image_urls.description: Optional input image URLs (editing or reference). Must be media hosted on the Imaginode account (Firebase Storage URLs from the media library or previous generations).

model.description: Model key from list_models (kind image). Default: nano-banana-2.

prompt.description: What to generate, in natural language. English works best.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.title: Generate an image

tools.description: Start a video generation from a text prompt (optionally with a start image). Returns immediately with a request_id and the cost in credits: poll get_generation_status every 30 seconds until it completes (typically 1 to 5 minutes, up to 30 for long jobs). Failures are refunded.

audio.description: Generate audio, for models that support it.

duration.description: Duration in seconds, among the model's durations (see list_models).

image_url.description: Optional start image URL (image-to-video). Must be media hosted on the Imaginode account (Firebase Storage URL from the media library or a previous generation).

model.description: Model key from list_models (kind video). Default: seedance-2.

prompt.description: What to generate, in natural language. English works best.

resolution.description: Resolution among the model's resolutions (see list_models).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.title: Generate a video

tools.description: Check a generation started with generate_video (or a generate_image that timed out). Returns running, completed (with output URLs) or failed (refunded).

request_id.description: The request_id returned by the generate tool.

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.title: Get generation status
